_comment: The café's production lines. Machines are placed on yard tiles in build mode (cost in coin). A servant assigned to a machine runs a cycle every cycleSec: takes `from` (from any machine holding it) and adds `makes` to the machine's stock (up to cap). Every cycle adds wear; at 1.0 the machine jams until the player fixes it (hold use for fixSec). from/makes null = hand-operated only (the sprinkle shaker tops a cone you carry, using sprinkles from your pockets), except the counter: its servant scoops a base plus the order's flavour from your pockets and serves the queue itself (no per-cat favour; only you win hearts), and hands out a cone from the cold box first when one fits. The cold box keeps up to cap things you carried (a wrong cone, a spare base) to take back later; the scrap bin throws away what you carry. The dehydrator keeps up to cap waffle cones (a full waffle stack hands you one with empty paws); wrapping a cone draws on the iron's stack, then a dehydrator. Workers (servants) walk a plan of machines like you do: cycleSec x 0.5 is their time to fish at the barrel or bake, holdSec x 2 for the rest; a machine with cycleSec 0 cannot be a direct-order station. Tier 2 (land = conquered regions needed to build): the smokehouse smokes fish, the velvet churn turns smoked fish into a velvet base (scoop it at the counter for a velvet cone), the waffle iron bakes waffles (empty paws, or a servant) and wraps a carried cone in one. Special customers order these.
_scale: scale = drawn size (1 = one prop cell); the sprite stays on its feet.
